title: Every Cech cochain lifts to one Koszul exponent
statement: Let A be a commutative ring, r a natural number, f : Fin r → A, and F an integer-indexed complex of sheaves of modules on Spec(A), with every F.X q quasi-coherent. For the specified diagram and cocone [def-sc-koszul-cech-comparison-construction], every element y of degree n of the principal alternating Cech total [def-sc-principal-open-alternating-total] is the image of a degree-n element z at a single stage e : ℕ under the cocone leg, transported to the specified target by its point equality. No cycle condition is assumed.

source.place: Tags 08D0 and 08D1, localization fraction map and finite total-degree diagonals; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D0 and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/08D1.

proof.text: Transport y through principalCechObjIso. The private finite_affine_denominators lemma uses Scheme.Modules.isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent and isIso_fromTildeΓ_iff_isLocalizing, then IsLocalizedModule.Away.surj for each signed component. Take the finite supremum of the denominator exponents and increase smaller numerators by the remaining power, obtaining one exponent e+1 for all nonempty subsets, including the empty index type when r=0.

The private koszul_basis_values lemma uses the exterior power of Finsupp.basisSingleOne. In source degree p<=0 use the extension isomorphism at (-p).toNat and Basis.constr with the prescribed numerator for each subset of cardinality (-p).toNat+1, transported along its target-degree equality. In source degree p>0 use zero. Cochain.mk forms the Hom cochain; exteriorPower.basis_apply and Basis.constr_basis verify its values on every koszulCechBasis.

Transport the constructed Hom cochain back by koszulCechHomObjIso.inv. Apply injectivity of principalCechObjIso.hom degreewise and function extensionality on subsets. Multiply by the common product power, which is injective on principal-open sections by Scheme.Modules.isSMulRegular_of_le_basicOpen and IsSMulRegular.pow. The specified equation of koszulCechCocone_exists and the exterior-basis value identify this product with the signed restriction of the numerator. The denominator equation and commuting scalar actions cancel the sign by inv_smul_smul. No cycle condition, boundedness, or arbitrary object choice is used.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08D0 and 08D1: common affine denominators, exterior-basis Hom cochains, and injective denominator cancellation; complete Lean proof by J4, 2026-10-13.

lean.statement:
theorem koszulCechCocone_stage_lifting
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (r : ℕ) (f : Fin r → A)
    (F : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (.of A)).toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hF : ∀ n : ℤ, (F.X n).IsQuasicoherent) (n : ℤ)
    (y : ((principalCechFunctor r f).obj F).X n) :
    ∃ (e : ℕ) (z : ((koszulCechHomDiagram A r f
      (((affineOpenSections A ⊤).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj F)).obj
        e).X n),
      (((koszulCechCocone A r f F).ι.app e ≫
        eqToHom (koszulCechCocone_exists A r f F).choose_spec.1).f n) z = y
